notes.title: Small update with bugfixes 2
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/u][/h2]

Fixed an issue where a certain log was only burnable on easy (auto-play) mode.

Changed it so that the Tune List when in 5-note mode (normal difficulty) now plays a 5-note version of the Tune instead of a full version.

Made the colors of HP and TP match the numbers that pop up when recovering HP and TP.

Fixed hats not being equipable in the very early game.

[h2][u][b]Balance changes:[/b][/u][/h2]

Made the Herbert fight a bit easier.

Made the first Chorval fight a bit easier.

notes.title: Small update with bugfixes
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/u][/h2]

Achievements on PC may not have been working for the first few days of release, they should now be fixed.

Achievements on Mac may still be bugged, a fix is in the works for this.

Fixed an issue where the top half of an ice pillar wouldn't melt unless you were facing up.

Fixed an issue where you could become stuck if you opened the Tune List just after learning the Fire Tune.

[h2][u][b]Balance changes:[/b][/u][/h2]

Made the fight just before the first boss battle a little easier.

Lowered the health of medics.
